cds.title: University of North Alabama Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; the page header still reads 2024-2025 but the data are for Fall 2025)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025 entering class): 6,847 applied, 4,800 admitted (70%); international 184 applied, 100 admitted (54%), 29 enrolled. Only 3% (28 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT scores and 74% (814) ACT, so the score ranges describe self-selected submitters. No early decision/action, no waitlist, no application closing date; notification is rolling. The file is labeled 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' on every page but reports Fall 2025 data. Undergraduate enrollment and nonresident count are the B1/B2 totals (8,437 total undergraduates; 352 nonresidents).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT/ACT not used in admission decisions ('We do not consider ACT or SAT scores for admission purposes. They are used for scholarship and placement purposes.').

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2026-27): in-state tuition $10,500 ($350 per credit hour x 30), nonresident $21,000 ($700 per credit hour), required fees $3,200, on-campus food and housing $11,050. CDS H6: 338 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (average $14,021, total $4,739,086); both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid boxes are ticked.
